n-main.text:
How to iterate

Refer to screens by ID: UF-03.1, UF-04.3 etc.

Suggest a change like: "UF-02.1: put the week strip under the workout card".

New screens get the next step number (UF-03.4). New flows get the next flow number (UF-08).

s-01.text:
Goal: get a personalised plan in under a minute.

Steps: Welcome → Goal → Level & equipment → Days & length → plan preview → Today.

Influence: Fitbod (goal + gear drive the plan), Hevy (short, skippable).

Open: account creation before or after the plan? Health data import?

s-02.text:
Goal: one tap from opening the app to training.

Steps: Today → (optional) preview → Start → UF-08 session setup.

Influence: Strong and Hevy home screens, week strip for consistency.

Open: rest-day content? Quick-workout generator?

s-03.text:
Classic list view. Now reached from Pause (UF-09.9) as "Show full list view".

Goal: log a set with one tap, no typing when you repeat last time.

Steps: Active session (tap check) → auto rest timer → next set … → Finish → Summary + PRs.

Influence: Strong's set table with Previous column; Hevy's PR celebration.

Open: Apple Watch / lock-screen timer; plate calculator.

s-04.text:
Goal: explain every exercise, including how variants differ (squat vs sumo).

Steps: Browse/search → Detail (muscles, how-to, research) → Compare variant → Add to routine or swap.

Influence: JEFIT and wger exercise pages; data from free-exercise-db.

Open: video vs illustration; body muscle map.

s-05.text:
Goal: replace an exercise mid-workout without breaking the plan.

Steps: Swap icon (UF-03.1) → pick variation / same muscles / busy-gym option → back to session.

Influence: Fitbod's replace sheet.

Open: carry weights over between variants?

s-06.text:
Goal: show consistency, weekly volume vs target and strength trends.

Steps: Overview (calendar, sets per muscle, PRs) → exercise history chart.

Influence: Hevy stats, Strong charts.

Open: body weight & measurements; share cards.

s-07.text:
Goal: edit exercises, sets and the progression rule.

Steps: Edit → reorder / remove → Add exercise (UF-04.1) → Save.

Influence: Hevy routines; Liftosaur's progression rules, in plain language.

Open: advanced rule editor for power users.

s-08.text:
Goal: from "I have 45 minutes" to a workout that fits, in three taps.

Steps: Start (UF-02) → .1 time, energy, warm-up → .2 suggestion with time-budget bar, why-chips, swap/remove per exercise, shuffle; switch 30/45/60 to see it adapt → .3 swap sheet asks why, ranks alternatives by match and time → .4 how focus mode works, sound settings, Start.

Influence: Fitbod (auto-generated, swap), Future (time-boxed), Nike Training Club.

Open: hard-stop clock time instead of minutes? Gym crowd level?

t-09.text: UF-09 · Focus mode: one step at a time

s-09.text:
Goal: during the workout show only what the next few seconds need.

Loop per set: .3 Set (weight × reps, plate loading, one cue, big Done) → .4 Confirm (pre-filled, auto-saves in 5 s) → .5 Rest countdown (runs by itself, orange in last 10 s) → back to .3.
Between exercises: .6 Next exercise with set-up countdown; .8 Time check only if behind budget.
Also: .1 5-second get ready, .2 timed warm-up, .7 timed holds, .9 pause holds everything else (swap, skip, list view, end).

Timers run live in Play.

Open: watch companion, voice cues, lock-screen live activity.
